items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7, 2026, with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of this CVE being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Account Takeover in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, enabling unauthenticated customer account takeover. This vulnerability was fixed as part of APSB26-92 and added to the CISA KEV catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical and important vulnerabilities. This includes an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: PolyShell: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via unrestricted file upload
items.summary: A very new vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload fake image files containing executable code, leading to remote code execution. As of March 2026, there was no official fix, only a pre-release of the 2.4.9 branch contained a fix.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical bug (CVSS 9.1) allowing customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions. Adobe released an emergency fix (APSB25-88) in September 2025, but mass exploitation was observed starting October 22, 2025, and continued into March 2026.
